tasks.label: Apple: Archive iOS App
tasks.command: mkdir -p build && xcodebuild -workspace ios/KidoCoach.xcworkspace -scheme KidoCoach -configuration Release -archivePath build/KidoCoach.xcarchive archive -allowProvisioningUpdates

tasks.label: Apple: Validate IPA (Pre-upload)
tasks.command: [ -f .env ] && export $(grep -v '^#' .env | xargs); if [ -z "$APPLE_ISSUER_ID" ] || [ "$APPLE_ISSUER_ID" = "PASTE_YOUR_ISSUER_ID_HERE" ]; then echo '❌ Missing APPLE_ISSUER_ID! Open .env and paste your Issuer ID from App Store Connect -> Integrations.'; exit 1; fi; xcrun altool --validate-app -f build/KidoCoach.ipa -t ios --apiKey "$APPLE_KEY_ID" --apiIssuer "$APPLE_ISSUER_ID"

tasks.label: Apple: Upload to TestFlight
tasks.command: [ -f .env ] && export $(grep -v '^#' .env | xargs); if [ -z "$APPLE_ISSUER_ID" ] || [ "$APPLE_ISSUER_ID" = "PASTE_YOUR_ISSUER_ID_HERE" ]; then echo '❌ Missing APPLE_ISSUER_ID! Open .env and paste your Issuer ID from App Store Connect -> Integrations.'; exit 1; fi; xcrun altool --upload-app -f build/KidoCoach.ipa -t ios --apiKey "$APPLE_KEY_ID" --apiIssuer "$APPLE_ISSUER_ID"

tasks.label: Simulator: Launch App
tasks.command: xcrun simctl bootstatus booted -b 2>/dev/null && xcrun simctl launch booted com.kidocoach.app

tasks.label: Simulator: Take Screenshot
tasks.command: mkdir -p screenshots && xcrun simctl io booted screenshot screenshots/screen-$(date +%Y%m%d_%H%M%S).png
